searchText: can anyone confirm its https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork3.ethdevops.io/ ? ie #3 being current mainnet shadow fork 3 is the one happening in the next ~8 hours No consensus was reached AFAIK but you can find more context here https://hackmd.io/@timbeiko/acd/https%3A%2F%2Ftim.mirror.xyz%2FPWFVaHY3Mrx7srarMmuBWya0J5kioR1l2xaH3p5APDk%3Fdisplay%3Diframe "Once Ropsten, Goerli and Sepolia have forked and stabilized (assuming no further issues are found) we will then be ready to set a merge date for mainnet!" I am not technical enough to participate in these shadowforks, but I am interested in how it went? Were there major issues or did it go well? <@725334340388651069> we discussed it this AM on a public call here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nnjeqZK7jgU&feature=youtu.be See a twitter recap here: https://twitter.com/christine_dkim/status/1522256793321103360 Thank you very much depends on the nature of the issue for exampl, one of the issues today was just with configuration. I'm happy to move forward if a configuration bug messed up 5% of the network
